comparison.objective: Identify a cable core with failed insulation using a hand-crank tester.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous cranking and probe placement followed by diagnosis and marking.
comparison.success_condition: All cores are tested, only the failed core is flagged, and the probe is returned.
comparison.reason: Its bimanual simultaneity serves electrical diagnosis; it does not preserve a screw setting against locknut torque or verify articulated motion.
